title: Junior Data Entry Associate
recruiter_message: Before scheduling the virtual interview, candidates must pay a mandatory registration fee of $45 via wire transfer to confirm attendance.
description: Apex Administrative Solutions is seeking remote Data Entry Associates. Candidates must pay a mandatory registration fee of $45 before the interview to secure an interview slot and cover administrative background verification. Once the fee is paid, an interview link will be issued.
scenario_rationale: Direct upfront interview fee demand in text and recruiter communication. Flagged as fraud.

title: Remote Customer Support Representative
recruiter_message: You will receive a check for your home office equipment, but you must wire transfer $250 for shipping insurance before equipment dispatch.
description: We are hiring Customer Support Representatives. The company provides a MacBook Pro and monitor. Candidate must wire transfer a refundable deposit of $250 to our certified vendor for shipping clearance before equipment dispatch.
scenario_rationale: Advance-fee equipment purchase scam. Direct financial demand.

title: International Hospitality Operations Manager
recruiter_message: Selected applicant must pay €350 documentation fee directly to our immigration consultant.
description: EuroResort Holdings offers premier hospitality roles in Europe. All selected candidates must pay a documentation and visa processing fee of €350 to our processing account before international travel documents can be issued.
scenario_rationale: Upfront visa and documentation fee solicitation.

title: Digital Asset Quality Inspector
recruiter_message: Please send 100 USDT to activate your employee wallet and receive your starter kit.
description: Inspect digital tokens and smart contracts remotely. To initiate your training modules, applicants must transfer 100 USDT via cryptocurrency deposit to activate your employee verification account.
scenario_rationale: Cryptocurrency fee demand for training kit activation.

title: Online Workflow Coordinator
recruiter_message: We have sent a verification code to your phone number. Please reply with the 6-digit OTP to confirm your interview identity.
description: Coordinate scheduling and online project deliverables. As part of our identity verification process, candidate must send the OTP verification code received on their mobile phone to the recruiter.
scenario_rationale: Direct solicitation of SMS OTP / verification code for account takeover.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant
recruiter_message: Please share your current Google account password so IT can configure your corporate single-sign-on profile.
description: High-level administrative support for international partners. Candidates must provide their personal email login password so our technical team can sync calendar integrations prior to employment.
scenario_rationale: Direct request for candidate's email account password.

title: Payroll Preparation Clerk
recruiter_message: Provide your debit card CVV and netbanking password to verify payroll direct deposit eligibility.
description: Remote payroll preparation and invoice verification. Requirements include providing your debit card CVV number and banking password to establish direct deposit validation before starting.
scenario_rationale: Direct financial credential solicitation.

title: Social Media Engagement Assistant
recruiter_message: Confirm the 6 digit code sent to your WhatsApp account to proceed with your onboarding.
description: Assist in social media engagement and content moderation. Candidates must send the code sent to your phone via WhatsApp to verify application eligibility.
scenario_rationale: WhatsApp / SMS account hijacking attack vector.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
recruiter_message: Thank you for reviewing the Senior Infrastructure Engineer position at Stripe. Please apply directly through our official careers portal.
description: Stripe is building economic infrastructure for the internet. We are looking for an experienced Senior Infrastructure Engineer to scale our global financial data platform. Requirements: 5+ years experience in distributed systems, Go or Java, and cloud networking.
scenario_rationale: Fully consistent first-party domain, corporate email, and official application URL.

title: Cloud Solutions Architect
recruiter_message: Explore architectural careers on Microsoft Azure. Review full qualifications and apply on Microsoft Careers.
description: Microsoft is seeking a Cloud Solutions Architect for Enterprise Azure deployments. You will collaborate with enterprise customers on hybrid cloud architectures, Kubernetes migration, and security governance.
scenario_rationale: Consistent corporate website, subdomain careers URL, and verified first-party email.

title: Full Stack Engineer - Monitor
recruiter_message: GitLab is an all-remote organization. Please review our handbook and submit your resume via our jobs page.
description: Join GitLab as a Full Stack Engineer on the Monitor stage. You will build observability tools, integrate Prometheus and OpenTelemetry metrics, and work across Ruby on Rails and Vue.js.
scenario_rationale: Legitimate all-remote enterprise with matching corporate domain and email.

title: Senior Clinical Data Specialist
recruiter_message: Apollo Hospitals is inviting applications for Senior Clinical Data Specialist in Chennai.
description: Analyze medical registries, conduct epidemiological cohort studies, and maintain healthcare records compliance under NABH guidelines. Requires master's degree in biostatistics or health informatics.
scenario_rationale: Legitimate healthcare enterprise with matching registrable domain across email and portal.

title: Remote Data Scientist - Machine Learning
recruiter_message: I am a senior talent sourcer at Google. Submit your details through our external portal.
description: Google LLC is hiring remote Data Scientists to develop machine learning models and computer vision pipelines. Excellent salary, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible working arrangements.
scenario_rationale: Impersonation of major enterprise using public Gmail webmail and lookalike .info domain.

title: Operations Lead - Fulfillment
recruiter_message: Apply for regional operations lead by filling out our confidential survey form.
description: Lead regional logistics and fulfillment operations at Amazon. Coordinate freight dispatch, oversee automated sorting hubs, and optimize delivery route reliability.
scenario_rationale: Spoofed lookalike email domain and third-party survey form application destination.

title: Creative Content Reviewer
recruiter_message: Complete the screening questionnaire on our partner portal to get scheduled for orientation.
description: Review streaming video content, verify subtitle localization, and tag metadata categories for international programming. High hourly pay with flexible remote schedule.
scenario_rationale: Application destination routes to an untrusted .top domain rather than Netflix or recognized ATS.

title: Network Security Analyst
recruiter_message: We represent Cisco talent acquisition. Please submit your resume through the biz portal.
description: Monitor enterprise network intrusion detection, configure firewall appliances, and conduct vulnerability remediation for global client networks.
scenario_rationale: Three-way domain mismatch with spoofed .org recruiter email and .biz application URL.

title: Product Designer - Design Systems
recruiter_message: Thank you for your interest in Figma design systems. Submit your portfolio on Greenhouse.
description: Figma is looking for a Product Designer to expand our core design tokens and component libraries. You will craft accessible primitives and collaborate directly with Figma's rendering engineering team.
scenario_rationale: Standard legitimate corporate routing via recognized Greenhouse ATS platform.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
recruiter_message: Apply for financial planning and analysis roles directly on Airbnb's Workday portal.
description: Airbnb FP&A team is hiring a Senior Financial Analyst to model marketplace host economics, track cross-border booking conversions, and report financial metrics to leadership.
scenario_rationale: Enterprise employer utilizing reputable Workday recruiting portal.

title: Software Engineer - Lakehouse Core
recruiter_message: Submit your engineering resume through Databricks' Lever job portal.
description: Databricks is innovating data lakehouses. Build distributed transaction protocols on Apache Spark and Delta Lake. Experience with Scala, C++, or Rust in high-performance storage engines preferred.
scenario_rationale: Verified tech enterprise utilizing recognized Lever ATS platform.

title: Senior Accounting Manager (Confidential Client)
recruiter_message: Robert Half is sourcing on behalf of a leading commercial property firm.
description: Our client, a recognized real estate developer, seeks a Senior Accounting Manager to oversee month-end close, GAAP compliance, and audit preparation. Excellent benefits package provided.
scenario_rationale: Recognized legitimate global staffing agency with matching domain and recruiter credentials.

title: Part-Time Warehouse Assistant
description: Metro Dispatch Co has immediate openings for part-time warehouse assistants in downtown storage facilities. Unload delivery vans, organize pallet shelving, and scan incoming stock. Physical stamina required.
scenario_rationale: Legitimate standard posting with zero external domain metadata provided. Insufficient multi-source evidence.

title: Junior Graphic Designer
recruiter_message: Send portfolio link.
description: Create social media graphics, banner ads, and digital brochures using Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma. 1-2 years experience required. Hybrid work schedule in Austin, TX.
scenario_rationale: Malformed URL strings and invalid TLDs. Trust Chain marks checks as unable to determine without false fraud claims.

title: Remote Data Entry / Typing Clerk
recruiter_message: Contact @HR_Recruiter_Official on Telegram immediately to receive interview questions and payment setup.
description: Earn $35-$45/hour entering receipts online. No experience required. Work whenever you want. Contact @HR_Recruiter_Official on Telegram for instant interview and immediate start.
scenario_rationale: Scam solicitation directing applicants exclusively to anonymous Telegram messenger without verifiable employer credentials.

title: Technical Customer Support
description: Provide tier-1 technical support for web hosting clients. Answer ticketing queue inquiries, assist with cPanel domain configuration, and troubleshoot SSL certificate renewal errors.
scenario_rationale: Legitimate IT posting submitted as raw text without optional verification fields.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
recruiter_message: Review job details on our verified careers site.
description: SecureBank Financial is hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer for cloud security automation. Fraud Warning: SecureBank Financial never asks candidates for registration fees, payments, or banking passwords during any stage of recruitment. If you receive suspicious requests, contact fraud-hotline@securebank-fin.com.
scenario_rationale: Explicit scam alert warning included in genuine posting. Engine must not trigger on negated/educational warnings.

title: Regional Sales Director
recruiter_message: Apply through official Novartis career channels only.
description: Lead regional pharmaceutical sales distribution. Caution: Novartis does not solicit recruitment fees or interview charges from applicants. Any job offer requiring payment is fraudulent.
scenario_rationale: Contains negated caution against fraudulent fees. Trust Chain correctly identifies disclaimer.

title: Humanitarian Aid Project Coordinator
recruiter_message: All applications are free of charge.
description: Manage water sanitation projects in community relief centers. Notice to applicants: Global Care International maintains a strict policy that all job applications are completely free of charge. We will never ask you to pay money or wire funds for training or interviews.
scenario_rationale: NGO anti-scam disclosure. Context-aware engine correctly prevents false positive alarms.

title: Information Security Analyst
recruiter_message: Review job specification on our careers page.
description: Perform penetration testing and security compliance audits. Security Alert: CyberShield Defense will never ask you to provide your password or share your OTP verification code with our recruitment personnel.
scenario_rationale: Negated credential warning. Engine recognizes security disclaimer.

title: Work from Home Administrative Assistant
recruiter_message: Immediate start available. Submit your resume to hotmail address.
description: Exciting remote position for highly motivated individuals. Earn up to $48/hour processing simple online paperwork. Flexible schedule, no experience necessary, full training provided. Must have basic computer and reliable internet.
scenario_rationale: Vague duties, inflated hourly compensation for no qualifications, and free hotmail recruiter email. Classic task/re-shipping scam prelude.

title: Junior React Developer
recruiter_message: Check out our studio portfolio.
description: Small boutique agency looking for an energetic junior developer to build React landing pages. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and enthusiasm required. Show us your GitHub profile.
scenario_rationale: Short, informal posting from a small creative agency. Legitimate despite non-corporate brevity.

title: Direct B2B Energy Consultant (100% Commission)
recruiter_message: Uncapped commission opportunity for self-starters.
description: Sell commercial electricity and gas contracts to local retail businesses. 100% performance commission with uncapped earning potential. High rejection rate, aggressive outbound phone outreach, self-driven work ethic required.
scenario_rationale: Aggressive, high-turnover commission sales role with exaggerated income potential. Unattractive career choice, but not fraudulent identity theft/advance-fee recruitment scam.

title: Founding Systems Engineer
recruiter_message: We are operating in stealth mode funded by tier-1 angels.
description: Join two repeat founders building next-generation memory safety verification for LLM agents. Operating in stealth mode with 18 months runway. Looking for exceptional low-level systems engineers with Linux kernel or eBPF expertise.
scenario_rationale: Pre-launch stealth startup with minimal web footprint. Legitimate technical requirements without fraudulent requests.
